luiskr.com / core/utils/gpu/divider-sheen / mountDividerSheen

function mountDividerSheen(hr, canvasClass): () => void;

Defined in: core/utils/gpu/divider-sheen.ts:185

Mounts the divider-sheen widget over an <hr> divider. Returns a disposer that releases the widget, the overlay canvas, the IO, and the rAF — call it from the host component's onDestroy (and call again on re-render: _updateDom swaps the <hr> node, so the old mount's canvas + observer must go with it).

Parameters

hr

HTMLElement

The divider element (aria-hidden already — the canvas is decorative paint on top of it).

canvasClass

string

The overlay canvas's class token — the stylesheet's :has() gate keys on it to hide the <hr> paint.

Returns

Teardown function; safe to call more than once.

() => void
